propositions: Tests entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan inherit the production 1200-second shutdown drain, causing unit tests to hang or run long-lived background reconciliation and snapshot janitor tasks

A test-scoped autouse fixture must bind SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0 seconds globally and stub reconcile_loop and start_background_janitor by default, with explicit markers and per-module overrides to opt into real behavior
The production default of 1200 seconds must remain unchanged in src/rebar/review_bot/config.py and configurable via the SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS environment variable
TestClient can enter the real application lifespan safely with the test-bound drain and stubs, completing in under 2 seconds without triggering background work
